d: Earth Alliance and galactic diplomatic hubs from J. Michael Straczynski’s Babylon 5.

gaia-5164707970261890560.x: Five-mile-long O’Neill cylinder space station stationed at the L5 Lagrange point of Epsilon Eridani III (Euphrates), serving as a neutral diplomatic and commerce haven.

gaia-5853498713190525696.x: Major Earth Alliance colony world in the Proxima Centauri system that declared independence during President Clark’s regime.

io.x: Volcanic Jovian moon hosting the primary Earth Alliance jumpgate providing hyperspace access to the Solar System.

mars.x: Subsurface domed settlements and headquarters of the Free Mars movement fighting for independence from Earth.

b.s: Groundbreaking serialized space opera centering on the diplomatic space station Babylon 5 in the Epsilon Eridani system.
